catalog.titleZh: NUR Dashboard
catalog.descZh: Network Unavailability Rate 深度分析，基于 RAN UME 数据按站点、区域与故障根因统计停机损失时长，与 MS SLA 看板口径对齐。
catalog.descEn: Network Unavailability Rate in-depth analysis, based on RAN UME data to calculate downtime loss duration by site, region and fault root cause, aligned with MS SLA dashboard caliber.

catalog.titleZh: GIS Map (全网故障与工单地理分布)

catalog.descEn: Leaflet-based Liberia network-wide GIS map, overlaying site faults, ticket distribution and transmission links, supports filtering by level/status and popup drill-down.

catalog.titleZh: Site Availability (站点可用率看板)
catalog.descZh: 按站点/制式（2G/3G/4G）统计月度与周度可用率，含低于阈值天数、VIP 站点、FME/主管维度与关联工单（总数/未结/已结），支持筛选与 Excel 导出。
catalog.descEn: Monthly and weekly availability per site and technology (2G/3G/4G), including days below threshold, VIP sites, FME/supervisor dimensions and related tickets (total/open/closed), with filtering and Excel export.

catalog.titleZh: VMAX CXO Original View (VMAX CXO 原版看板)
catalog.titleEn: VMAX CXO Original View (Legacy VMAX CXO Dashboard)
catalog.descZh: VMAX CXO Dashboard 原版视觉复刻页，与简化版 CXO Dashboard 完全独立，保留 VMAX 原有决策视图的指标口径与呈现方式，便于新旧口径对照核查。
catalog.descEn: A faithful reproduction of the original VMAX CXO Dashboard, fully separated from the simplified CXO Dashboard. It preserves the original metric definitions and layout so the legacy and current views can be cross-checked.

catalog.titleZh: MTTR Dashboard Monthly&Weekly (平均修复时间分析)
catalog.titleEn: MTTR Dashboard Monthly&Weekly (Mean Time To Repair Analysis)
catalog.descZh: 【MS 目录】故障平均修复时间 MTTR（Mean Time To Repair）周度/月度走势与各专业响应时延。
catalog.descEn: [MS Directory] Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) weekly/monthly trends and response latency by specialty.

catalog.titleZh: RealTime Alarm Map (实时告警地图)
catalog.descZh: 以 GIS 地图红点形式实时呈现 eFlow Active 告警分布，与 Alarm Dashboard 时间口径统一，快速定位区域性故障聚集。
catalog.descEn: Network-wide real-time alarm geographic distribution based on FM Active data, supports filtering by alarm level, specialty and region, click site popup to view alarm details.

catalog.titleZh: Alarm Management (告警管理)
catalog.descZh: 告警全生命周期管理：告警确认、派单、关闭与统计，支持按时间/区域/级别多维筛选与 Excel 导出。
catalog.descEn: Alarm full lifecycle management: alarm acknowledgment, dispatch, closure and statistics, supports multi-dimensional filtering by time/region/level and Excel export.

catalog.titleZh: TT&WO Dashboard (故障与运维工单流转看板)
catalog.descZh: Trouble Ticket (TT) 与 Work Order (WO) 工单生命周期闭环追踪、SLA 处理时效与分区完成率，全部组件支持下钻表格、列筛选排序与 Excel 导出。
catalog.descEn: Trouble Ticket (TT) and Work Order (WO) lifecycle closed-loop tracking, SLA processing timeliness and regional completion rate, all components support drill-down tables, column filtering/sorting and Excel export.

catalog.titleZh: Availability Dashboard (TT Related) (工单关联可用性)
catalog.descZh: 【FO 目录】将网络停机可用率损失与具体 Trouble Ticket (TT) 故障工单精确关联溯源。
catalog.descEn: [FO Directory] Precisely correlate network downtime availability loss with specific Trouble Ticket (TT) fault tickets for tracing.

catalog.titleZh: RAN Cells KPI (RAN 小区可用率达标看板)
catalog.titleEn: RAN Cells KPI (RAN Cell Availability Compliance)
catalog.descZh: 按 2G/3G/4G 制式逐日统计小区可用率达标情况：达标 / 未达标 / 无数据小区数与占比，以及整月可用率汇总；达标阈值默认 99.65% 可调，各统计数字可下钻到具体小区清单并导出 Excel。
catalog.descEn: Daily availability compliance per technology (2G/3G/4G): counts and ratios of meeting / below-threshold / no-data cells plus a month-to-date availability roll-up. The compliance threshold defaults to 99.65% and is adjustable; every figure drills down to the underlying cell list and can be exported to Excel.

catalog.titleZh: 2G_Daily_KPI
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】2G GSM 掉话率 Call Drop Rate、拥塞率、话务量 Erlang 及无线接通率 Daily 报表，数据由 RAN UME 每日同步。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] 2G GSM Call Drop Rate, congestion rate, traffic volume Erlang and wireless connection rate Daily report, data synced daily by RAN UME.

catalog.titleZh: 3G_Daily_KPI
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】3G UMTS CS 语音与 PS 数据吞吐量、HSDPA 速率、软切换成功率 Daily 统计。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] 3G UMTS CS voice and PS data throughput, HSDPA rate, soft handover success rate Daily statistics.

catalog.titleZh: 4G_KPI_Daily
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】4G LTE RRC 连接建立成功率、E-RAB 掉线率、下行吞吐量 Throughput 与 VoLTE 质量分析。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] 4G LTE RRC connection establishment success rate, E-RAB drop rate, downlink throughput and VoLTE quality analysis.

catalog.titleZh: FW_Daily_KPI (防火墙安全与出口流量日报)
catalog.titleEn: FW_Daily_KPI (Firewall Security & Egress Traffic Daily Report)
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】核心防火墙会话并发数、攻击拦截事件、国际出口吞吐量及安全告警，每日 07:15 自动同步并邮件图表。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] Core firewall session concurrency, attack interception events, international egress throughput and security alarms, auto-synced daily at 07:15 with email charts.

catalog.titleZh: CN KPI _V2 (核心网性能与附着成功率 V2)
catalog.titleEn: CN KPI _V2 (Core Network Performance & Attach Success Rate V2)

catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] Core Network PS domain attach success rate, SGSN/MME load, SGW/PGW traffic and user plane latency.

catalog.titleZh: CN Monthly KPI (核心网月度综合运营报表)
catalog.titleEn: CN Monthly KPI (Core Network Monthly Comprehensive Operation Report)
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】核心网容量规划、月度峰值话务量、计费 CDR 记录完整性及长期扩容建议报表。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] Core network capacity planning, monthly peak traffic volume, billing CDR record integrity and long-term expansion recommendation reports.

catalog.titleZh: Packet Loss Dashboard
catalog.descZh: 监控 IP RAN 回传链路时延、抖动与丢包率（站点级聚合口径），每日 06:30 同步数据、06:45 自动邮件日报，定位传输质量劣化。
catalog.descEn: IP RAN network-wide packet loss rate monitoring, based on iPRAN UME data to calculate packet loss rate, latency and jitter by site, region and link, supports drill-down details.
catalog.dept: 传输与 IP 网管部

catalog.titleZh: MW Topology (微波网络拓扑看板)

catalog.descEn: Microwave network link topology and site connections based on UME MW management data, supports date-slider lookback, link status coloring and faulty link drill-down.
catalog.dept: 传输与 IP 网管部

catalog.titleZh: MW Real-Time (微波实时 NOC 看板)
catalog.descZh: MW UME 微波网络实时 NOC 监控大屏：链路实时状态、告警与性能指标持续刷新，支持日期回溯与链路明细下钻，快速定位微波传输中断。
catalog.descEn: MW UME real-time NOC monitoring dashboard: live link status, alarms and performance metrics continuously refreshed, with date lookback and link detail drill-down to quickly locate microwave transmission outages.
catalog.dept: 传输与 IP 网管部

catalog.titleZh: IP Trace (IP 链路探测诊断)
catalog.descZh: 端到端 IP 报文追踪与路由跳数检测，对骨干网链路节点进行实时探测，快速定位传输中断与劣化段落。
catalog.descEn: IP link trace tool: supports traceroute/mtr visualization, packet loss rate and hop count statistics, quickly locate transmission bottlenecks.

catalog.titleZh: IP RAN Region KPI (IP 承载网分区性能报表)
catalog.titleEn: IP RAN Region KPI (IP Bearer Network Regional Performance Report)
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】各行政区 IP RAN 承载网路由器端口利用率、MPLS 隧道时延与链路丢包率，数据由 iPRAN UME 每小时同步。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] IP RAN bearer network router port utilization, MPLS tunnel latency and link packet loss rate by administrative region, data synced hourly by iPRAN UME.

catalog.titleZh: IP RAN (IPCORE HQ-ODC & Banjor/ELWA & OLT)

catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] IPCORE core aggregation nodes (HQ-ODC, Banjor, ELWA) and OLT upstream backbone ring link dashboard.

catalog.titleZh: IP RAN Metor Ring KPI (城域环网性能 KPI)
catalog.titleEn: IP RAN Metor Ring KPI (Metro Ring Network Performance KPI)
catalog.descZh: 【BO 目录】城域网光纤环路负载均衡度、保护倒换状态与波分系统健康度。
catalog.descEn: [BO Directory] Metro network fiber ring load balance, protection switching status and WDM system health.

catalog.titleZh: Material Summary (备件物料库存与消耗汇总)
catalog.descZh: SP 备件 WH/DOP 汇总报表：按 1st WH / 2nd WH / Gbarnga DOP / Kweaken DOP / Others 统计期初与当前库存（剔除 damaged 件）、待维修件与报修出库，支持锚点日 / 本月 / 本周三个消耗窗口对比，行列可下钻到明细并导出 Excel。
catalog.descEn: WH/DOP spare parts summary report: opening and current stock by warehouse (1st WH / 2nd WH / Gbarnga DOP / Kweaken DOP / Others, damaged items excluded), items pending repair and repair outbound, with three consumption windows (anchor day / current month / current week), drill-down to row/column details and Excel export.

catalog.titleZh: Battery Dashboard
catalog.descZh: 基站动环蓄电池监控：充放电曲线、市电停电续航时长与电池组老化预警，每小时同步（:05），每日 07:00/19:00 自动邮件报表。
catalog.descEn: Battery and power environment monitoring: battery voltage, temperature, charge/discharge status and alarms, supports filtering by site/region and historical trend analysis.

catalog.titleZh: Task Manager (任务管理 / 自动化调度总控)
catalog.descZh: 调度全部 34 个自动化任务：ZTE eFlow API 同步、RAN/iPRAN/CNN UME KPI、电池、丢包、邮件日报与 WhatsApp 推送，支持手动触发、失败自动重试与 Cron 修改。
catalog.descEn: Schedules all 34 automation tasks: ZTE eFlow API sync, RAN/iPRAN/CNN UME KPI, battery, packet loss, email reports and WhatsApp push, supports manual trigger, auto-retry on failure and Cron modification.

catalog.titleZh: Settings (系统设置 / 凭据管理)
catalog.descZh: 系统凭据集中管理（credentials 表）、邮件收件人配置与系统参数设置，支撑多设备部署的凭据统一维护。
catalog.descEn: Centralized credential management (credentials table), email recipient configuration and system parameter settings, supporting unified credential maintenance for multi-device deployment.

catalog.titleZh: Portal Login (网管门户一键登录)

catalog.descEn: Centralized account management and one-click auto login for NMS portals (UME / eFlow), showing live login status per portal with retry and session close.

catalog.titleZh: RAG Knowledge Q&A (本地知识问答 / Open WebUI)

catalog.descEn: Locally deployed RAG knowledge Q&A system powered by Open WebUI; supports natural-language search and conversational queries over internal documents and the O&M knowledge base. Available to everyone.

catalog.titleZh: eFlow Knowledge Base (eFlow 知识库 / TT 快速分析)
catalog.titleEn: eFlow Knowledge Base (eFlow Docs & TT Quick Analysis)
catalog.descZh: eFlow 告警与工单知识库：规则/经验文档目录树、全文检索与 TT 工单快速分析（根因归属、CSD/PSD、派单判定与时效），支撑一线快速定位与派单。
catalog.descEn: eFlow alarm & ticket knowledge base: a catalog tree of rules/experience docs, full-text search and TT quick analysis (root-cause ownership, CSD/PSD, dispatch rules and timeliness) to help front-line staff locate faults and dispatch quickly.

catalog.descEn: Built-in help and user manual for my_app (Data Insight MVP): feature notes, per-dashboard usage guides and FAQs to help new users get started quickly.

catalog.titleZh: Issue Feedback (问题反馈 / 建议提报)
catalog.descZh: my_app 内置问题反馈工单台：提交功能缺陷、数据异常与改进建议，支持分类（缺陷/数据/需求/其他）、优先级与状态流转，管理员可指派处理人并回填解决结论，支持按状态/分类筛选与关键字检索。
catalog.descEn: Built-in issue desk for my_app: report functional defects, data anomalies and improvement ideas with a category (defect / data / requirement / other), priority and status workflow. Administrators can assign owners and write back resolutions, with filtering by status/category and keyword search.

catalog.titleZh: Customer Service KPI (客户业务 KPI)
catalog.descZh: 客户业务 KPI 健康度看板：按 UME KPI 服务逐日统计调用次数、成功数与成功率，拆分系统侧 / 用户侧失败，并对资源类指标（容量 / 已用 / 空闲）做均值与峰值监控，异常自动生成告警，支持趋势下钻。
catalog.descEn: Customer service KPI health dashboard: per UME KPI service it tracks daily attempts, successes and success rate, splits system-side vs user-side failures, and monitors resource metrics (capacity / used / free) by average and peak, auto-raising alerts on breach with trend drill-down.

catalog.titleZh: CXO Daily Dashboard (CXO 90 天经营看板)
catalog.descZh: 面向 CEO 的经营视角大屏：直连 VMAX 数仓（GBase zxvmax）取最近 90 个已完成日，支持日 / 周粒度切换。顶部卡片给出总流量、活跃用户、视频体验等主指标及周同比 / 月同比，下方为业务结构（视频 / 缓存 / 游戏）、网络质量（建链成功率 / 重传 / 时延）趋势与最近 14 天明细，上游缺数日单独标注。
catalog.descEn: CEO-facing business dashboard: queries the VMAX warehouse (GBase zxvmax) directly for the last 90 completed days, with day / week granularity switching. Hero cards show total traffic, active users and video experience with WoW / MoM deltas; below are service-mix (video / cache / gaming) and network-quality (success rate / retransmission / latency) trends plus the last 14 days of detail, with upstream data gaps flagged.

catalog.descEn: SP spare parts summary report built from the SpareParts Inbound/Outbound/Inventory workbook generated daily at 05:15 by task sp_report_generate: KPI cards (inventory, avg monthly consumption, safety stock, replenishment), replenishment & exception alerts, daily inbound/outbound matrix and detail tables, with drill-down and Excel export - same source file as the emailed report.

catalog.titleZh: Consumables Report (耗材出入库与库存汇总报表)

catalog.descEn: SP consumables summary report sharing the same source and layout as the spare parts report: built from the Comsumables Inbound/Outbound/Inventory workbook generated daily at 05:15 by task sp_report_generate, with inbound/outbound & inventory statistics, replenishment and exception alerts, daily matrix, drill-down and Excel export.
